Senior Security Operations Engineer, Incident Response
Location: San Mateo, CA, United States

Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.  
 At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.  
 A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone. 
 As a Senior Security Operations Engineer of Incident Response, you will be a hands-on responder, leading the investigation, containment, and remediation of security incidents across our environment. Outside of active incidents, you’ll build and tune detections, automate triage and response workflows, and improve the tooling and runbooks the team relies on. You’ll work closely with SOC operations to improve the quality of our alerts, partner with teams across the company during investigations, and help shape the roadmap for the Security Incident Response Team. Your work will directly protect Roblox’s platform, developers, and millions of users.
 You will: 
• Respond to security incidents: Investigate, contain, and remediate incidents from start to finish. Serve as Incident Commander for high-severity events.
• Build and tune detections: Write new detections and improve existing ones based on threat intelligence, incident findings, and coverage gaps. Work with SOC operations to reduce noise and make alerts more accurate.
• Automate response: Find manual, repetitive work in triage and response, and automate it with SOAR and custom tooling.
• Threat hunt: Run hypothesis-driven hunts informed by threat intelligence, and turn what you find into new detections.
• Improve process and documentation: Write and maintain runbooks, response plans, and workflows so the team responds consistently.
• Learn from incidents: Run blameless post-incident reviews and tabletop exercises, and turn lessons learned into concrete improvements.
• Partner across the company and grow the team: Work with Legal, Privacy, Comms, HR, and Engineering during incidents and on response planning. Mentor teammates and help shape the SIRT roadmap.
 You have: 
• Experience: 5+ years of experience across Infosec, IT, Infra/SRE, and/or Incident Response.
• Investigation skills: Hands-on experience investigating incidents across endpoints, cloud, and network, including log analysis and forensic triage.
• Incident command: You’ve led high-severity incidents, stayed calm under pressure, and kept stakeholders (including leadership) clearly informed.
• Detection engineering: Experience writing and tuning detections in a SIEM, with a focus on reducing noise and improving signal.
• Automation: Comfortable scripting (e.g., Python) and building automated response workflows with SOAR or similar tools.
• Security tooling: Deep hands-on experience with SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS, and SOAR.
• Frameworks: Working knowledge of IR frameworks (NIST, SANS) and threat frameworks (MITRE ATT&CK, Cyber Kill Chain), and you know how to apply them in your day-to-day work.
• Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field; advanced degree preferred or equivalent experience.
 For roles that are based at our headquarters in San Mateo, CA: The starting base pay for this position is as shown below. The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand.  Annual Salary Range

 Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).
